textures.displayName: Clear cyan rink ice with broad white cracks
textures.generationPrompt: Create a square seamless tileable game albedo texture of stylized blue frozen lake ICE, inspired ONLY by the ice surface in the provided winter racing reference. Output a flat orthographic top-down texture, no scene, no perspective, no objects, no snow border, no landscape, no text. Smooth clear azure and turquoise ice interiors, softly varying mid blue translucent-looking cells, with a sparse interconnected network of crisp branching WHITE frozen cracks. Primary cracks bold enough to remain visible at a low racing-camera angle, about 4-8 pixels wide per 1024 image, smaller occasional hairline branches. Large irregular natural polygonal ice regions, approximately 12-18 cells across the entire tile. Very little fine grain: eliminate speckle, foam, stipple, marble micro-veins, frosty noisy patches and scratch noise. High contrast clean white cracks against rich mid cyan-blue, soft internal depth variation within each cell. Friendly polished animated-game style matching the reference's ice palette. This is an opaque RGB color texture: no actual transparency. Perfectly SEAMLESS and TILEABLE on BOTH horizontal and vertical axes; all lines and colors continue across opposite edges, full bleed, no border, no edge shading or vignette, evenly lit albedo without reflections of scene objects or cast shadows. Only the ice texture fills the entire square.

assets.displayName: Clear cyan rink ice with broad white cracks
assets.generationPrompt: Create a square seamless tileable game albedo texture of stylized blue frozen lake ICE, inspired ONLY by the ice surface in the provided winter racing reference. Output a flat orthographic top-down texture, no scene, no perspective, no objects, no snow border, no landscape, no text. Smooth clear azure and turquoise ice interiors, softly varying mid blue translucent-looking cells, with a sparse interconnected network of crisp branching WHITE frozen cracks. Primary cracks bold enough to remain visible at a low racing-camera angle, about 4-8 pixels wide per 1024 image, smaller occasional hairline branches. Large irregular natural polygonal ice regions, approximately 12-18 cells across the entire tile. Very little fine grain: eliminate speckle, foam, stipple, marble micro-veins, frosty noisy patches and scratch noise. High contrast clean white cracks against rich mid cyan-blue, soft internal depth variation within each cell. Friendly polished animated-game style matching the reference's ice palette. This is an opaque RGB color texture: no actual transparency. Perfectly SEAMLESS and TILEABLE on BOTH horizontal and vertical axes; all lines and colors continue across opposite edges, full bleed, no border, no edge shading or vignette, evenly lit albedo without reflections of scene objects or cast shadows. Only the ice texture fills the entire square.
